material_definitions: Preparations and physico-chemical characterizations of NASICON-type compounds in the system $Li_{1+x}Al_xA_{2-x}^{IV}(PO_4)_3$ ($A^{IV}=Ti$ or Ge) are described.
Ceramics have been fabricated by sol-gel and cogrinding processes for use as ionosensitive membrane for Li+ selective electrodes.
Solid solutions are obtained with Al/Ti and Al/Ge substitutions in the range $0 \le x \le 0.6$.

 g) values were measured for Li+-NASICON membranes with composition Li1.3Al0.3A1.7(PO4)3 where A=Ti or Ge.
